How conversion is calculated

Convert between common length, mass, volume, temperature, area, speed, and energy units with explicit source and destination units. Conversions use fixed ratios or the standard affine temperature equations, so temperature offsets are not treated as simple multipliers. 10 miles is 16.09344 kilometers; 32°F is 0°C. The calculation validates each input and keeps its stated units explicit. Celsius and Fahrenheit have different zero points, so their conversion includes both a scale and an offset. This is an estimate for the stated assumptions; confirm measurements and any applicable professional or local standards before relying on it.

Conversion Calculator is calculated from the supplied measurement fields using the units shown.

Assumptions & useful context

The result depends on the values you enter and the method described above. Displayed numbers may be rounded; calculations use the unrounded values. Check that this model matches your situation before relying on it.

Frequently asked questions

Why can temperature conversions have an offset?

Celsius and Fahrenheit have different zero points, so their conversion includes both a scale and an offset.

Are fluid ounces and ounces interchangeable?

No. One measures volume and the other mass; select units within the same dimension.
